---
title: "Summarizing Linear Models with linregpack"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
devtools::install_github("vibonvallet/linregpack")
library(linregpack)
```

## Overview

The `linreg_summary()` function produces a detailed summary of a linear regression fit, including:

- Coefficients and standard errors
- R-squared and adjusted R-squared
- Residual statistics

## Usage

```{r}
# Fit model
data <- data.frame(
  x = 1:10,
  y = 2*(1:10) + rnorm(10)
)
fit <- linreg_fit(y ~ x, data)

# Summary
summary_out <- linreg_summary(fit)
print(summary_out)
```

## Notes

- Useful for comparing fits across datasets.
- Provides similar output to `summary(lm(...))` for benchmarking.
